defect: RG1 GAPS 1: for a recorded building, officer buildingDossier compares the latest completed check's inputFingerprint with currentAreaCheckFingerprint(area), which loaded every recorded feature of the area against the 2,000 limit; a recorded building of an area that grew past 2,000 after a completed check answered 422 AREA_LIMIT, and so did createInvestigation (officer-investigations.ts ~115) and updateInvestigation (~279).

D1_whatAndHow.purpose: the fingerprint answers whether the latest completed check still describes the area's analytical inputs: sha256 of the features a check hashes (the area's recorded features and its groups' members, less its own source-only declarations, which withNeighbours drops for null geometry, plus crossing neighbours), their occupies_parcel associations, the area reference and the validator name. The area revision alone does not carry it: neighbours, group members and associations change without an area revision.
D1_whatAndHow.bounded: areas.ts checkedAreaFeatures reads only the features a check hashes (CHECKED_FEATURES_SQL: the loadAreaFeatures predicate plus f.area_id<>$1 OR f.body->'geometry' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb), LIMIT 2,001. An area whose feature count (the map_areas listing's existing aggregate) is over 2,000 is first counted by SELECT count(*) FROM (... LIMIT 2001), so its bodies are read only when they fit.
D1_whatAndHow.whyExact: every stored fingerprint hashes at most 2,000 features: runAreaCheck reads them through areaContext (2,000 limit) and withNeighbours refuses more than 2,000 with neighbours. When the features the hash would cover exceed 2,000 (by the count, the bounded read, or withNeighbours' AREA_LIMIT), the hashed list differs from every stored one, so currentAreaCheckFingerprint returns null and every caller's !== comparison reports the check not current. Otherwise it hashes the same list as before: the SQL predicate removes exactly the rows withNeighbours filtered (same-area rows whose body geometry is JSON null; other-area rows always carry a projected geometry or projectedFeatures refuses), keeping identifier order.
D1_whatAndHow.equality: test 'a small area fingerprints its check exactly as the area check does' (NYC-shaped fixture of RG1 with one source-only declaration): a completed check holding the new fingerprint is reported current by areaContext's checkIsStale, which still computes the old formula over loadAreaFeatures; a different fingerprint is reported stale. The same test passes with areas.ts at 2ddefbbb.

decisions.D2_notCurrent: not needed as a fallback: the null answer is exact (see whyExact). The dossier shows it through the existing check.stale true and drops the check's findings as it already does for a stale check.
decisions.D3_investigations: createInvestigation and updateInvestigation call the same currentAreaCheckFingerprint; with null they answer their existing 409s ('This check is stale...', 'The investigated inputs have changed...') instead of 422 AREA_LIMIT. officer.ts and officer-investigations.ts needed no edit (their !== comparisons accept string | null).
decisions.D4_scope: no change to how checks run or are stored, no schema change, no contract field. docs/api/source-pins.json repinned for areas.ts; openapi.json and schema.d.ts regenerated with no content change.
